package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"time"
)

func persistedItemID(pathID string, item domain.LearningPathItem) string {
	if item.ID != "" {
		return item.ID
	}
	return uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte(pathID+":"+item.ReferenceType+":"+item.ReferenceID)).String()
}
func requirementsJSON(item domain.LearningPathItem) []byte {
	r := item.FrozenRequirements
	if r == nil {
		r = []domain.LessonRequirement{}
	}
	b, _ := json.Marshal(r)
	return b
}
func nullableContent(b json.RawMessage) any {
	if len(b) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	return b
}

func (repo *LearningJourneyRepoPG) GetLessonItem(ctx context.Context, studentID, itemID string) (domain.LearningPathItem, error) {
	var pathID string
	err := repo.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT p.id::text FROM student_learning_path p JOIN student_learning_path_item i ON i.student_learning_path_id=p.id WHERE p.student_id=$1 AND i.id=$2`, studentID, itemID).Scan(&pathID)
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.LearningPathItem{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathItem{}, err
	}
	p, err := getLearningPathByID(ctx, repo.Pool, studentID, pathID, false)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathItem{}, err
	}
	for _, i := range p.Items {
		if i.ID == itemID {
			return i, nil
		}
	}
	return domain.LearningPathItem{}, domain.ErrNotFound
}
func (repo *LearningJourneyRepoPG) ApplyLessonFact(ctx context.Context, f domain.LessonActivityFact) (domain.LearningPathItem, bool, error) {
	tx, err := repo.Pool.Begin(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathItem{}, false, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()
	item, changed, err := applyLessonFactTx(ctx, tx, f)
	if err != nil {
		return item, false, err
	}
	if err = tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
		return item, false, err
	}
	return item, changed, nil
}
func applyLessonFactTx(ctx context.Context, tx pgx.Tx, f domain.LessonActivityFact) (domain.LearningPathItem, bool, error) {
	if _, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended($1,0))`, "learning-path:"+f.StudentID); err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathItem{}, false, err
	}
	var pathID string
	err := tx.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT p.id::text FROM student_learning_path p JOIN student_learning_path_item i ON i.student_learning_path_id=p.id WHERE p.student_id=$1 AND i.id=$2`, f.StudentID, f.ItemID).Scan(&pathID)
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.LearningPathItem{}, false, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathItem{}, false, err
	}
	path, err := getLearningPathByID(ctx, tx, f.StudentID, pathID, true)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathItem{}, false, err
	}
	var item domain.LearningPathItem
	index := -1
	for j, i := range path.Items {
		if i.ID == f.ItemID {
			item = i
			index = j
			break
		}
	}
	if index < 0 {
		return item, false, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	// The receipt is authoritative and immutable across later route changes.
	b, _ := json.Marshal(struct{ Student, Item, Requirement, Type, Source, Revision string }{f.StudentID, f.ItemID, f.RequirementID, f.Type, f.SourceID, f.SourceRevisionID})
	h := sha256.Sum256(b)
	hash := "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(h[:])
	var old string
	err = tx.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT request_hash FROM student_lesson_activity_fact WHERE source_type=$1 AND fact_id=$2`, f.Type, f.FactID).Scan(&old)
	if err == nil {
		if old != hash {
			return item, false, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		return item, false, nil
	}
	if !errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return item, false, err
	}
	if path.Status != domain.LearningPathStatusActive && path.Status != domain.LearningPathStatusPaused {
		return item, false, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	// A theory acknowledgement is a new learner command; authoritative late
	// assessment/Practice outcomes are facts and deliberately bypass admission.
	// Exact accepted fact replay has already returned above.
	if f.Type == "theory_acknowledged" {
		if _, err := validateLessonCommandAdmissionTx(ctx, tx, f.StudentID, f.ItemID, f.RequirementID); err != nil {
			return item, false, err
		}
	}
	updated, changed, err := domain.SatisfyLessonRequirement(item, f)
	if err != nil {
		return item, false, err
	}
	if _, err = tx.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO student_lesson_activity_fact(source_type,fact_id,student_id,item_id,requirement_id,request_hash,occurred_at) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7)`, f.Type, f.FactID, f.StudentID, f.ItemID, f.RequirementID, hash, f.OccurredAt); err != nil {
		return item, false, err
	}
	if !changed {
		return item, false, nil
	}
	if _, err = tx.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE student_learning_path_item SET status=$2,reason_code=$3,frozen_requirements=$4 WHERE id=$1`, item.ID, updated.Status, updated.ReasonCode, requirementsJSON(updated)); err != nil {
		return item, false, err
	}
	path.Items[index] = updated
	path.Version++
	previousUpdate := path.UpdatedAt
	path.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
	if path.UpdatedAt.Before(previousUpdate) {
		path.UpdatedAt = previousUpdate
	}
	if path.UpdatedAt.Before(path.CreatedAt) {
		path.UpdatedAt = path.CreatedAt
	}

	if _, err = tx.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE student_learning_path SET version=$2,updated_at=$3 WHERE id=$1`, path.ID, path.Version, path.UpdatedAt); err != nil {
		return item, false, err
	}
	if _, err = tx.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE student_learning_context SET version=version+1,updated_at=$2 WHERE student_id=$1`, f.StudentID, path.UpdatedAt); err != nil {
		return item, false, err
	}
	if err = insertLearningPathRevision(ctx, tx, path); err != nil {
		return item, false, err
	}
	return updated, true, nil
}

func (repo *LearningJourneyRepoPG) ReplayLearningPathCreation(ctx context.Context, student, key, plan, hash string) (domain.StudentLearningPath, bool, error) {
	path, s, p, h, err := getLearningPathByRequest(ctx, repo.Pool, "idempotency_key", key)
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return path, false, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return path, false, err
	}
	if s != student || p != plan || h != hash {
		return path, false, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return path, true, nil
}
func (repo *LearningJourneyRepoPG) ReplayLearningPathCommand(ctx context.Context, c domain.LearningPathPlanningCommand) (domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandResult, bool, error) {
	result, r, err := getLearningPathCommandReceipt(ctx, repo.Pool, "idempotency_key", c.IdempotencyKey)
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return result, false, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return result, false, err
	}
	if r.StudentID != c.StudentID || r.LearningPathID != c.LearningPathID || r.PlanningRequestID != c.PlanningRequestID || r.Kind != c.Kind || r.ExpectedPathVersion != c.ExpectedPathVersion || r.RequestHash != c.RequestHash {
		return result, false, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return result, true, nil
}

func activateLessonItemTx(ctx context.Context, tx pgx.Tx, studentID, itemID string, now time.Time) error {
	var pathID string
	err := tx.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT p.id::text FROM student_learning_path p JOIN student_learning_path_item i ON i.student_learning_path_id=p.id WHERE p.student_id=$1 AND i.id=$2`, studentID, itemID).Scan(&pathID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	path, err := getLearningPathByID(ctx, tx, studentID, pathID, true)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	changed := false
	for j, i := range path.Items {
		if i.ID != itemID {
			continue
		}
		if i.Status == domain.LearningPathItemPlanned || i.Status == domain.LearningPathItemReady {
			path.Items[j].Status = domain.LearningPathItemInProgress
			path.Items[j].ReasonCode = "lesson_activity_started"
			changed = true
		}
		break
	}
	if !changed {
		return nil
	}
	if now.Before(path.UpdatedAt) {
		now = path.UpdatedAt
	}
	path.Version++
	path.UpdatedAt = now
	if _, err = tx.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE student_learning_path_item SET status='IN_PROGRESS',reason_code='lesson_activity_started' WHERE id=$1`, itemID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err = tx.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE student_learning_path SET version=$2,updated_at=$3 WHERE id=$1`, path.ID, path.Version, now); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err = tx.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE student_learning_context SET version=version+1,updated_at=$2 WHERE student_id=$1`, studentID, now); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return insertLearningPathRevision(ctx, tx, path)
}

// validateLessonCommandAdmissionTx is for new learner commands only. Reads and
// correlated official outcomes retain their own ownership/lifecycle boundary.
func validateLessonCommandAdmissionTx(ctx context.Context, tx pgx.Tx, studentID, itemID, requirementID string) (domain.LearningPathItem, error) {
	if err := lockStudentAdmissionFence(ctx, tx, studentID); err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathItem{}, err
	}
	var pathID string
	err := tx.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT p.id::text FROM student_learning_path p JOIN student_learning_path_item i ON i.student_learning_path_id=p.id WHERE p.student_id=$1 AND i.id=$2`, studentID, itemID).Scan(&pathID)
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.LearningPathItem{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathItem{}, err
	}
	path, err := getLearningPathByID(ctx, tx, studentID, pathID, true)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathItem{}, err
	}
	journey, err := getLearningContext(ctx, tx, studentID, true)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathItem{}, err
	}
	if path.Status != domain.LearningPathStatusActive || journey.SelectedLearningPathID != path.ID {
		return domain.LearningPathItem{}, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	for _, item := range path.Items {
		if item.ID != itemID {
			continue
		}
		if !lessonCommandProgressionAllowed(path.Items, item.Position) {
			return item, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		for _, r := range item.FrozenRequirements {
			if r.ID == requirementID {
				if r.Satisfied {
					return item, domain.ErrConflict
				}
				return item, nil
			}
		}
		return item, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return domain.LearningPathItem{}, domain.ErrNotFound
}

// Existing NBA item progression is an admission constraint. The semantic
// ordering used to present requirements is not an inter-requirement prerequisite.
func lessonCommandProgressionAllowed(items []domain.LearningPathItem, position int) bool {
	found := false
	for _, item := range items {
		if item.Position == position {
			found = item.Status == domain.LearningPathItemPlanned || item.Status == domain.LearningPathItemReady || item.Status == domain.LearningPathItemInProgress
			continue
		}
		if item.Status == domain.LearningPathItemInProgress || (item.Position < position && item.Status != domain.LearningPathItemCompleted && item.Status != domain.LearningPathItemSkippedMastered) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return found
}
